item.title: Echigo-Tsumari Art Field: Contemporary Art Across Rice Terraces — Guide
item.description: Echigo-Tsumari Art Field is the site of one of the world’s largest international art festivals (Triennale), held every three years since 2000, though a substantial number of installations remain permanently on display across a sprawling rural area covering roughly 760 square kilometres. Works by artists from dozens of countries are integrated into the landscape of terraced rice paddies, forests, abandoned schools and traditional farmhouses, creating an unusual art-viewing experience that doubles as an exploration of depopulating rural Japan and its efforts at revitalisation through contemporary art.
